cando.ja: ともだちが でんわで やくそくの よていを かえるのを まちの ざつおんの なかで きいて、あたらしい ひ・じかん・ばしょと キャンセルか どうかが わかる
cando.short: よていの へんこうが わかる
cando.en: I can follow a friend changing our plans on the phone, over street noise at natural speed, and catch the new day, time and place, and whether they're really cancelling.

choices: It's moved to Thursday, same place, at seven.
It's moved to Thursday, a new place, at seven.
It's moved to Tuesday, same place, at seven.
It's still tonight, but at seven.
He's cancelling and hasn't set a new date.
He's moving it to a date he'll message.
He wants to meet but somewhere quieter.
He's on his way, just tired.

ph.ja: きゅうようが できた

日にちが ないなら ほぼ キャンセル

items.speaker: kicks
items.en: Hey, I'm running about ten minutes late. My train stopped.
items.ja: ごめん、10分くらい遅れてる。電車が止まっちゃって。 →「大丈夫、先に席とっとくね。」
items.note: running late＝遅れそう。走って いない
choices: No worries, I'll grab us a table.
Sure, see you at ten, then!

items.en: Mind if I take a rain check on drinks tonight? I'm wrecked.

items.note: push back＝あとに ずらす
choices: She wants to meet an hour later.
She wants to meet an hour earlier.

items.en: Hey Coco, about the beach tomorrow. Have you seen the forecast? I know, it's meant to bucket down. Shall we take a rain check? Yeah. How about next Saturday instead? Same time? Next Saturday works. I'll put it in my calendar. Talk soon!
items.ja: 代わりに来週の土曜に行く。
items.note: rain check でも 日にちが 決まれば キャンセル ではない
choices: They're going tomorrow in the rain.
They've cancelled with no new date.
items.ask: ビーチは どうなる？
